question: How many Centres of Excellence (CoE) were inaugurated by the Union Minister of State for Rural Development in June 2025 in Chennai?
solution:
The correct answer is 3__**00**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In June 2025, the Union Minister of State for Rural Development, Shri Kamlesh Paswan, inaugurated 300 Centres of Excellence (CoE) during an event in Chennai.
 
• These centres were established in collaboration with Garuda Aerospace to advance drone innovation, research, and skill development across India.
 
• Agri-Drone Indigenization Facility: Along with the 300 CoEs, the Minister inaugurated a state-of-the-art facility in Chennai for the design and manufacturing of Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS).
 
• Train the Trainer (TTT): The event also marked the launch of a DGCA-approved program to certify educators as drone instructors.
 
• Strategic Goal: These initiatives support the Prime Minister’s vision of making India a global drone hub and empowering rural communities through technology like the "Namo Drone Didi" program.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lakhpati Didi Scheme**:

 
 
• This is a flagship initiative of the **Government of India** aimed at enabling rural women in **Self-Help Groups** to earn a sustainable income of at least **Rs. 1 lakh** per annum.
 
• In the **Interim Budget 2024**, the target for the number of **Lakhpati Didis** was increased from **2 crore** to **3 crore** women.
 
• The scheme focuses on diversified livelihood activities, including **agriculture**, **livestock**, **handicrafts**, and **service sectors**.
 
 
 
• **DAY-NRLM (Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana)**:
 
 
• Launched by the **Ministry of Rural Development** in **June 2011**, it is one of the world's largest initiatives to improve the livelihoods of the poor.
 
• It aims to organize the rural poor into **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)** and continuously nurture them until they exit **poverty**.
 
• The mission has mobilized over **10 crore** women into approximately **90 lakh** SHGs across **India**.
 
 
 
• **Role of Centres of Excellence (CoEs)**:
 
 
• The **100** newly inaugurated centers provide specialized support in **product design**, **packaging**, **branding**, and **marketing**.
 
• They help **SHG** members access **global markets** and **e-commerce platforms** like the **GeM (Government e-Marketplace)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Financial Inclusion**: A key function of these centers is to facilitate **bank linkages** and provide **financial literacy** to rural women, ensuring they have access to **credit** and **insurance**.
 
• **Technological Advancement**: The CoEs encourage the adoption of **digital tools** and **modern machinery** in rural production processes to improve **efficiency** and **quality**.
 
• **Institutional Support**: The **NIRD&PR** acts as the apex body for **research** and **training** in rural development, playing a crucial role in the management and curriculum design of these **100** centers.
 
• **Social Impact**: By targeting **3 crore** women, the government aims to bridge the **gender income gap** and promote **women's leadership** at the grassroots level in **India**.
